# Peptides4Pets

Peptides4Pets is South Africa's first COA-verified pet peptide line —
research-grade peptides and collagen for dogs, cats and horses.

Status: in development. Products are NOT yet for sale, are NOT veterinary
medicines, and no pet peptide product is approved by the FDA or SAHPRA.
Every formula is vet-guided: always consult your veterinarian before
starting, stopping or changing anything your pet takes.

What we stand for: research-grade synthesis, >=99% HPLC purity, and a
certificate of analysis (COA) on every batch. Evidence is graded honestly —
we publish what exists and what doesn't (e.g. collagen peptides have
published canine RCTs; BPC-157 has canine pharmacokinetic data; KPV and
TB-500 remain preclinical).

Formulas in development: BPC-157, KPV, Recovery Blend (BPC-157 + TB-500),
Immune (Thymogen), Mobility Collagen, plus pipeline blends (Calm, Immune+,
Senior Vitality).

Key pages:
- /science  — the evidence library, every claim cited
- /verify   — batch to certificate-of-analysis lookup
- /blog     — evidence-first writing on pet peptides and longevity
- /editorial-policy — sourcing, evidence grading, corrections and commercial disclosure
- /feed.xml — RSS feed for the Peptides4Pets Journal
- /waitlist — join the founding waitlist (no payment; consult your vet)

Domain: https://pets.peptide-south-africa.com
Parent brand: Peptide South Africa (https://peptide-south-africa.com)
